q01:
SELECT 
    r.name AS region, 
    SUM(ol.amount_cents) AS revenue_cents
FROM 
    orders o
JOIN 
    customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN 
    regions r ON c.region_id = r.region_id
JOIN 
    order_lines ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
WHERE 
    o.status ='shipped' 
    AND o.ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY 
    r.region_id
HAVING 
    SUM(ol.amount_cents) > 0
ORDER BY 
    revenue_cents DESC

q13:
WITH fiscal_quarters AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE
            WHEN strftime('%m', ordered_at) BETWEEN '04' AND '06' THEN 'Q2'
            WHEN strftime('%m', ordered_at) BETWEEN '07' AND '09' THEN 'Q3'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS fiscal_quarter,
        order_id
    FROM orders
    WHERE strftime('%Y', ordered_at) = '2026'
),
net_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        fiscal_quarter,
        SUM(amount_cents * qty) AS revenue_cents
    FROM fiscal_quarters fq
    JOIN order_lines ol ON fq.order_id = ol.order_id
    WHERE fiscal_quarter IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY fiscal_quarter
)
SELECT 
    'FQ2' AS fiscal_quarter, 
    revenue_cents AS revenue_cents
FROM net_revenue
WHERE fiscal_quarter = 'Q2'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'FQ3' AS fiscal_quarter, 
    revenue_cents AS revenue_cents
FROM net_revenue
WHERE fiscal_quarter = 'Q3'

WITH revenue_by_region AS (
    SELECT 
        c.region_id,
        r.name AS region,
        SUM(ol.amount_cents) AS net_revenue
    FROM 
        orders o
    JOIN 
        customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN 
        regions r ON c.region_id = r.region_id
    JOIN 
        order_lines ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    LEFT JOIN 
        refunds rf ON o.order_id = rf.order_id
    WHERE 
        o.status ='shipped' 
        AND o.ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
        AND rf.refund_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 
        c.region_id, r.name
    HAVING 
        SUM(ol.amount_cents) > 0
)
SELECT 
    region,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_revenue DESC) AS rank_no
FROM 
    revenue_by_region
ORDER BY 
    rank_no
